4686.answer:
func bezierPoint(controls, t) = {
  local p0 = controls[1]
  local p1 = controls[2]
  local p2 = controls[3]
  local p3 = controls[4]
  local mt = 1 - t
  local x = mt^3*p0[1] + 3*mt^2*t*p1[1] + 3*mt*t^2*p2[1] + t^3*p3[1]
  local y = mt^3*p0[2] + 3*mt^2*t*p1[2] + 3*mt*t^2*p2[2] + t^3*p3[2]
  [x, y]
}

func gouraudShading(vertices, normals, lightDir, baseColor) = {
  local colors = []
  for (i: 1 .. vertices.listLen()) {
    local n = normals[i]
    local dot = n[1]*lightDir[1] + n[2]*lightDir[2] + n[3]*lightDir[3]
    local d = if (dot > 0) dot else 0
    local ka = 0.2
    local kd = 0.8
    local intensity = ka + kd * d
    local r = floor(baseColor[1] * intensity)
    local g = floor(baseColor[2] * intensity)
    local b = floor(baseColor[3] * intensity)
    colors.add(makeColor([if (r>255) 255 else r, if (g>255) 255 else g, if (b>255) 255 else b]))
  }
  colors
}

  local d1 = (ax-cx)*(ax-bx) + (ay-cy)*(ay-by)

  local d = (ax-cx)*(by-ay) - (ay-cy)*(bx-ax)

4365.problem: Compute the bearing (compass heading in degrees) from point `(lat1,lon1)` to `(lat2,lon2)` using the spherical trigonometry formula for initial bearing.
4365.answer:
func bearing(lat1,lon1,lat2,lon2) = {
  local pi = 3.14159265358979
  local dLon = radians(lon2-lon1)
  local rlat1 = radians(lat1)
  local rlat2 = radians(lat2)
  local y = sin(dLon)*cos(rlat2)
  local x = cos(rlat1)*sin(rlat2) - sin(rlat1)*cos(rlat2)*cos(dLon)
  local b = degrees(atan2(y, x))
  mod(b + 360, 360)
}

4490.problem: Given a list of 2D points on a parametric curve, estimate the curvature at each interior point using finite differences.
4490.answer:
func curvature(pts) = {
  local result = []
  for (i: 2 .. pts.listLen()-1) {
    local dx1 = pts[i][1]-pts[i-1][1]
    local dy1 = pts[i][2]-pts[i-1][2]
    local dx2 = pts[i+1][1]-pts[i][1]
    local dy2 = pts[i+1][2]-pts[i][2]
    local cross = dx1*dy2-dy1*dx2
    local len1 = sqrt(dx1*dx1+dy1*dy1)
    local len2 = sqrt(dx2*dx2+dy2*dy2)
    local denom = len1*len2*(len1+len2)/2
    result.add(if (denom > 0) cross/denom else 0)
  }
  result
}
println(curvature([[0,0],[1,0],[2,0],[3,0],[2,1]]))

4574.problem: Given a dict of animation keyframes with 2D position and orientation, compute intermediate frames by linearly interpolating between keyframes.
4574.answer:
func interpolateKeyframes(keyframes, numFrames) = {
  local frames = []
  for (i: 1 .. numFrames) {
    local t = (i-1) / (numFrames-1)
    local kn = keyframes.listLen()
    local ki = floor(t * (kn-1)) + 1
    local kj = if (ki >= kn) kn else ki + 1
    local lt = t * (kn-1) - (ki-1)
    local a = keyframes[ki]
    local b = keyframes[kj]
    local x = a.get("x",0) + lt*(b.get("x",0)-a.get("x",0))
    local y = a.get("y",0) + lt*(b.get("y",0)-a.get("y",0))
    local rot = a.get("rot",0) + lt*(b.get("rot",0)-a.get("rot",0))
    frames.add({"x":x,"y":y,"rot":rot,"frame":i})
  }
  frames
}

  local row = []
  for (c: 1 .. spiralCols) { row.add(0) }
  spiralGrid.add(row)

local sc = 1
local sd = 1

  spiralPath.add([sr, sc])

    nr = sr + dirs4641[sd][1]
    nc = sc + dirs4641[sd][2]
  }
  sr = nr
  sc = nc
}
